scope: CVG-004 bounded on-demand server-backed inventory-stock report/export

criteria.description: The report grain, exact ten-field contract, filters, current-value derivation, permission, bound and non-promotion exclusions are frozen.
criteria.limitations: Vetus evidence establishes the report surface and business role but not an authoritative dynamic-executor schema; the bounded local contract is explicit about that limitation.

criteria.description: The existing tenant-scoped inventory_items repository and ReportsService execution/export boundary provide an additive implementation path without a migration.
criteria.limitations: The local source supports current persisted item facts; lots, movements, invoices and historical valuation are not part of this gate.

criteria.description: Focused TDD and disposable PostgreSQL evidence can prove exact mapping, tenant isolation, filter semantics, fail-closed behavior and server-side SPA export.
criteria.limitations: The implementation, independent critique and fresh verification are required before a bounded result is recorded.

gaps: The RED tests, implementation, independent critique and post-implementation regression are not complete at gate creation.

authority.actor: Ricardo (repository owner), via the original consolidation brief
authority.scope: CVG-004 bounded on-demand server-backed inventory-stock report/export
authority.decision: Authorize reversible repository, API and SPA implementation with focused tests and disposable PostgreSQL verification using only tenant-scoped persisted inventory_items. Exclude scheduled worker resolution, historical/as-of stock, lots, invoices, historical valuation, providers, fiscal writes, credentials, target, production, deployment, backfill and release acceptance.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before adding lot, movement, invoice, historical/valuation semantics, scheduled delivery, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment or release activity.

next_action: Write and run the intentional RED module/API/SPA tests, then implement the smallest tenant-scoped persisted current-stock projection and audited export.
revalidation_triggers: Changes to inventory item schema, balance/cost semantics, tenant repository queries or report authorization
Changes to ReportsService execution/export or Report Workbench behavior
Expansion beyond current persisted inventory_items facts
